hints.title: Determining Dominated Spans
hints.text: For each element nums[i], find the widest subarray window in which nums[i] serves as the strictly minimum element.

hints.title: Nearest Smaller Boundary Indices
hints.text: Use monotonic stacks to compute the previous smaller element index and next smaller element index for every array position.

hints.title: Suffix Propagation of Maximums
hints.text: If an element is a candidate minimum for window size L, it also qualifies for any smaller window; propagate values backwards from n down to 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Monotonic stack boundary detection followed by suffix dynamic programming propagation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every subarray of length k takes O(N^2) or O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear time stack sweeps calculate spans for all elements with O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonic stack for nearest smaller neighbors and suffix sweep.
